batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c C Bosch b SN Thakur

batting.name: Suryansh Shedge
batting.dismissal: c RA Bawa b SN Thakur

batting.name: Azmatullah Omarzai
batting.dismissal: c WG Jacks b DL Chahar

batting.name: RD Rickelton
batting.dismissal: c Priyansh Arya b Azmatullah Omarzai

batting.name: Naman Dhir
batting.dismissal: c Arshdeep Singh b M Jansen

batting.name: SE Rutherford
batting.dismissal: c XC Bartlett b Azmatullah Omarzai

balls.text: pinged on the pad, and the umpire gives it out! Vinod reviews, but it will be immaterial either way, apart from stats purposes! Low full toss, zinged into off. Vinod shapes for the sweep and gets his front pad outside the line. The ball, though, goes past his front pad and his bat to hit him on the back leg. Impact could still be a saviour for Vinod, and Ball Tracking confirms it. Impact outside off, and the decision is overturned!
low full toss, slanting into middle and leg. Vinod clinks it to long on and Bartlett hares back to the danger end. Vinod makes it too, quite comfortably
another slower ball, although this ends up as a full toss outside off. Bartlett swings for the hills and misses. Vinod sharp enough to pinch a bye
nails the slower yorker but the line is the problem. A touch beyond the tramlines and the umpire calls it a wide once Bartlett swishes and misses
full toss on the stumps, Bartlett backs away and drills it towards mid off, who dives sharply to his right and saves a certain boundary
zipped in full on off. Bartlett has a huge hoick at it and drags it behind square past short fine leg. Rutherford loses his footing again and that makes the second a comfortable exercise

and Bumrah concedes a boundary off the first ball too! Very full and zoning into the stumps. Bartlett squirts it out past short fine leg and Rutherford, chasing after it on the fence, slips at the last moment to let in four!
sizzling yorker, tailing into leg. Bartlett ends up on the deck trying to dig it out and somehow regains his balance to then scamper across to the other end

another dropped catch, and MI keep shelling chances! Banged in short outside off. Bartlett loads up and swats it flat to long on. Too hot to handle for Tilak, who also did not get himself behind the ball, nor did he get his hands into the right position while jumping to his right!
Bartlett wants a piece of the action too! Juicy full toss outside off. Bartlett transfers his weight onto the front foot and pops it over the bowler!
into the blockhole outside off. Vinod cannot get under it and clinks it out to long on

palmed over the bar, and MI drop another catch! Minz the guilty party this time. Half-tracker outside off. Vinod smashes it straight to deep mid wicket, and Minz ends up pushing it beyond the fence. Flicked the finger tips at the end of his hand and went away!
that has flown off the bat too! Over-pitched on middle and off. Vinod plants his front foot and blisters it past mid off!

chipped to long on, and Omarzai's party is over! Full toss on off and this is there to be hit too. Ought to have been thumped into the mountains but Omarzai does not get under it enough. Hits it flat and hits it straight to long on. A very handy cameo, but someone else will have to shepherd this innings now!
what a shot that is! Banged half-way down and this is another slower ball. Omarzai uses the width and crunches it over deep cover!
follows up the four with a six! Slower ball but in the slot outside off. Omarzai bends his back knee and slams it flat over long off!
four more! Juicy full toss on the stumps and it gets the treatment it deserves. Omarzai whips it away to deep square leg's left
slow and short outside off. Omarzai reaches out for ti and slaps it towards long off
knuckle-ball on a length outside off. Vinod gets forward and punches it to long off

Omarzai continues on his merry way! He is not bothering about the wickets falling at the other end. He stands tall to this back of a length ball outside off, and wallops it over the wide long on fence!
back of a length, following the batter just outside leg. Not much room to work with and Omarzai prods it back towards the bowler
full and angling into the pads. Vinod tucks it towards deep square leg to open his account
full just outside off. Vinod gets onto the front foot and pokes it back to the bowler

another nip-backer, and Jansen is outta here too! This one, like the ball that got Shashank, also keeps low. Shortish outside off and Jansen's eyes light up. He thinks he can swat this over cow corner but the lack of bounce and the inward nip means his stumps are exposed. Ball ends up hitting middle stump two-thirds of the way up, and Shardul has four!
darted in on a length on the pads. Jansen cannot do much with it and the ball rolls off his pads towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Jansen stands up tall and hacks it to long on
slower low full toss outside off. Jansen picks it early enough but drills it straight to mid off
another superb yorker, zoning into middle and off. Omarzai clinks it out to the left of the pitch and Jansen is alert enough to sneak in a run
banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
zinged into the blockhole on middle and leg. Omarzai jams down on it and digs it out to mid off
shorter outside off. Jansen stands up on his toes and punches it towards deep point
hard length, nipping into off. No room to work with and Omarzai plonks it towards extra cover
pushed in on a length on off. Keeps a little low again but Jansen adjusts, defending with a straight bat
slanted in on a length on middle and off. Jansen hangs back and turns it towards mid wicket

rapped on the pad, and given! Shashank reviews! Back of a length in the channel and this decks back in, while also keeping a little low. Shashank, hopping around his crease, misses it. He might have a prayer, though, because the impact may have been outside the line. There is a spike on UltraEdge before the ball hits the pad but the bat is not close enough to the ball at that moment. Umpire's Call on Impact, and Ball Tracking has the ball crashing into the top of off. Shashank has to go, and Bosch has his first wicket for the evening!
back of a length on the stumps. Omarzai drops it into the off side and keeps things ticking
right out of the screws! Back of a length on middle and leg. Omarzai plants his front foot and whacks it over mid wicket!
hard length, zoning into middle and off. A bit of extra bounce and the ball hits near the sticker. Bobbles back to the bowler
length just outside off. Punched on the up to sweeper cover
back of a length on middle and off. Omarzai hops up onto his toes and plays it back to the bowler
off the mark in style! Too full and too much into the pads. Omarzai brings his wrists into play and whips it over mid wicket!
slanted in full on middle and off. Omarzai comes forward and pushes it to mid off

oh, what a stunning grab, and Shardul, just like that, has three! Full and slanting into the pads. Shedge laces his flick but the only problem is he hits it in the air and too close to Bawa at mid wicket. The youngster flies to his left and makes it stick. Shedge cannot believe it and MI, who began the night by dropping a sitter, have now taken a sharp catch to pile further misery on PBKS!
back of a length on the stumps. Shashank gets a half stride forward and knocks it to long on
hold the pose, chief! Right in the slot outside off. Shedge comes forward, shows the maker's name and creams it over mid off!
on a length outside off. Shedge has a jab at it and clinks it down to deep third. Back for a couple of runs
very full outside off. Shashank digs it out to mid off and opens his account
full and sliding down leg. Shashank misses his flick and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
speared down leg, and Shashank does not even bother with it. Called a wide

stumps rattled again, and PBKS are falling apart! Hard length on middle and leg, and this skips through. Connolly looks to force the issue through the off side but is late on the stroke. Beaten for pace and the ball breezes past the outside edge before thumping into the top of off. Bawa with a muted celebration, and PBKS lose their fourth!
back of a length on leg. Connolly stays leg side of the ball and jabs it to extra cover
Slower ball on a length just outside leg. Connolly plays too early and the ball rolls off his body into the off side
Fuller side of length just outside off, defended from the crease to point
Pitched up on leg, flicked to midwicket

Pat Cummins would be proud of that! 132ks length ball angles in, lands on off stump and straightens despite being a cross-seamer to kiss top of off. Add 10ks to that and that's Cummins to Root from 2019. Four off the stumps to deep-third boundary. Shreyas was in the crease and looked to defend to cover, played the line and missed it, instinctively took off for the run only to turn back and see the bails missing.
Delightful square drive, played so very late. Both feet in the crease as he hit it off a length through backward point. Shardul hides his face in his shirt and yells

Prabhsimran perishes while accelerating. Got across to off stump and cleared the front leg to try and slog the 130ks cross-seamer over midwicket. It was a slot ball but went right up, off the outer-edge of the bat.

Prabhsimran uses the bowler's pace on a pitch that's been two-paced, and that too to a knuckle ball! He stayed back in the crease for the back-of-length ball, was inside the line and launched a fine pull
Wide and short, spongy bounce. Half-volleys to the keeper after the batter leaves it
Back of length on leg, screeches in as Prabhsimran makes room. He manages to fend it to cover for a quick single. 100 up for PBKS
Short ball angling in hurries him on the pull, top edge goes fine and to the deep
Touch back of length on leg, 141ks, flicked to deep square leg's left. Fifty up for Prabhsimran, 29 balls, excellent on this pitch
Length outside off, cut off the bottom-half to pint
Prabh ducks and doesn't get enough bounce for the upper cut. The shortish ball isn't middled and nearly carries to deep third, he stops it while sliding left
Slot ball. Spanked inside out over cover. Prabh is beside the line of the full ball and powered it through the line
Teasing ball wide on a length. Cut was on as it angled away, Connolly went too hard and was beaten. 92ks, front of the hand again
Looks to pick-up sweep while getting his head across to the off side. Full ball takes the edge and goes on the bounce to short fine leg
Slapped to long-off on the front foot
Slog swept again. Line was perfect for the shot, it was on a length and was hit on the rise. Prabh got low and rolled his wrists to get it square
Gets across to slog sweep on one knee over midwicket. This was a touch too full if at all, slightly outside off. More of a pre-meditated shot
Flatter and a touch short outside off, cut to backward point
This is wide too but Connolly wants a piece of it. Plonks the front foot across, reaches out and cuts through point
Way too wide. Length ball let go after Connolly took a step across
Beaten on the cut. Jacks surely is revving the ball a lot. 91ks and shortish, turns away a bit to beat bat
Cut to cover. This is wide on a length, goes straight. 90ks
Bit of spin in. This looked quicker, still 86ks. Length on middle, Connolly shows all stumps and drives to cover
Loopity loop and it's a touch too short at that pace, not so much in general. Connolly stays still and drives it through cover after a long wait, beats the sliding fielder
Back of length just outside off, it's slow off the pitch and bounces low. Cut back to the bowler
shortish outside off and this skids through. Prabh shapes for the cut but misses it. Wants the wide but does not get it
fuller on middle and off. Connolly digs it out towards extra cover and saunters across to the other end

this has gone a country mile! Search for that ball in the mountains! Floated up into the slot on middle and leg. Connolly gets his front foot out of the way and clubs it over long on. A 102m six, and that ball has still not landed!
fired in full outside off. Prabh gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long off
back of a length on the pads. Connolly waits for it and nudges it into the wide mid on region
how has that missed the stumps?! Googly fizzed through full on off. Connolly goes fishing at it and gets beaten on the outside. Perilously close to off stump too
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Prabh wafts at it and is beaten by the extra pace

dropped again - this is contagious! Fullish just outside off and this sticks in the surface. Prabh pops it back to the bowler, and Bosch puts down a fairly regulation chance. Ball seemed to come at him quicker than expected but he will be disappointed with that
back of a length outside off. Connolly has a jab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket. Hares across to complete the run
shortish outside off. Connolly gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point
angled in full on off. Prabh gets a half stride forward and pokes it to long on
zipped in full just outside off. Connolly comes onto the front foot and drives it to long on
loose ball and put away! Full and sneaking down leg. Prabh uses the pace and angle, and glances it past short fine leg!
shortish, slanting into middle and off. Connolly gets up on his toes and dabs it towards deep backward point to open his account
oh! Back of a length in the channel. Nips back in with the angle and Connolly, wafting at it, gets beaten on the inside

zing bails go flying, and Chahar breaks through! Back of a length, pitching outside off and coming in with the angle. Arya has a slog at it but seems to be early on the stroke. Might have been a knuckle ball, which explains why Arya was through the shot early. The ball crashes into the top of middle and leg, and Arya has to go!

more runs - unlucky for the bowler, though! Nails the yorker but this tails just down leg. Arya misses his flick and the ball passes between his pads and the stumps. Rickelton cannot dive swiftly enough to his right, and PBKS get four byes!
slower bumper just outside off. Arya backs away and throws his hands at it. Does not make contact and the umpire calls it one bouncer for the over
short, wide and punished! This is another hit-me ball. Prabh throws his hands at it and scorches it through point. That flew to the fence!
dropped short again and this sneaks inside the tramlines on the off side. Prabh advances and then lets it go. Wide not called, rightly
serious whippage! Angled in on a length on middle and off. Prabh plants his front foot and whips it behind square!
tries to follow the batter outside leg but sprays it further down. Prabh misses his flick and the umpire calls it a wide
four more! Back of a length and sliding down leg. Prabh uses the angle and swings it away past short fine leg!
another shank, but Arya continues to ride his luck! Hard length on middle and leg. Arya hacks at it and musters just enough on it to clear cover
in the air but safe! Back of a length on middle and off. Ball hits high on the bat as Prabh swipes at it and he gets it just over mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Arya presses half forward and taps it into the off side
Arya taking Bumrah on again! Slower short ball outside off. Arya spots it early and muscles it over mid wicket. Not off the middle but enough on it!
back of a length on the pads. Prabh tucks it towards deep backward square leg
safe again! Hard length, climbing through on middle and off. Arya is awfully rushed on the pull and splices it. Somehow gets it over the bowler, and between mid off and mid on!
back of a length, honing into middle and off. Arya opens his bat face and guides it towards backward point
uff, this is some stroke! On a length just outside off. Arya springs forward and thumps it on the up over cover!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Prabh swings at it wildly and chalks it off the toe-end towards the keeper
fullish outside off, shaping away a hint. Prabh gets a good stride in but drives it straight to extra cover
shorter and wider. Prabh throws his hands at it but slaps it straight to cover point
banged in short outside off. Prabh skips down the track and scuffs it towards cover point
length outside off. Arya gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up past extra cover
dispatched! Half-tracker outside off. Arya picks up the slower one and bashes it over mid wicket. Easy pickings!
back of a length, zoning into middle and off. Prabh lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
slanted in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Prabh hangs back and prods it into the on side
insult to injury! Shorter, wider and Prabh capitalizes. He throws his hands at it and slashes it over backward point!

dropped - oh dear! Back of a length on off and this snakes away after pitching. Prabh has to play at it and gets squared up. Gets a healthy outside edge and Dhir puts down an absolute soda at slip. In and out!
first boundary for Prabh! Back of a length, drifting into the pads. Prabh uses the pace and tickles it into the fine leg fence!
pushed in on a length on middle and leg. Arya comes half forward and pokes it to mid on for a single
length ball hung up wide outside off. Arya throws his hands at it and chalks it towards deep point
back of a length outside off, shaping away. Prabh waits for it and runs it down to deep backward point
full again, angling into middle and off. Seems like a change-up and Arya turns it into the mid wicket region
full just outside off. Arya gets onto the front foot and drives it straight to extra cover. He timed that very well
up and over! Arya is underway! Full and shaping away outside off. Arya plants his front foot, covers the swing and flays it over cover!
length ball in the channel and this straightens against the angle a touch. Arya comes forward and defends

Tilak finishes it off in style! A stunning hit to cap off a truly stunning innings, and the Punjab Kings lose for the fifth time in a row! Banged in short outside leg. Tilak spots the length early and he swivels to clatter this flat over the long leg fence. He wheels away in celebration soon after and then leaps into the air in delight. He has pulled this game out of the fire, and he has inflicted further misery on the Punjab Kings, who have now lost five on the spin, and are now in real danger of missing the playoffs!

oh goodness me - that is a shot right out of the top drawer! Cometh the hour, cometh Tilak Varma! Short and wide, and rather than dragging it, Tilak goes off side. He gets his hands through the ball and creams it off the back foot over extra cover. Incredible shot. Under such pressure!
a failed scoop, and that is a vital, vital dot! Back of a length, hung up a mile outside off. Tilak tries to get it over short fine leg but does not make any contact!
goes for the short ball outside off. Seems like the slower variant and Jacks chops it towards deep backward point
fetch that from the stands, says Jacks! Low full toss outside off and that is just what Jacks wants. He goes dead-straight and pumps it over long off!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Jacks cannot get under it and he clinks it towards sweeper cover

scraped past the keeper, and Jacks keeps MI alive in the game! More or less the perfect yorker outside off, but Jacks' game awareness is on point. He peels the outer cover off the ball and scythes it past the keeper!
full toss outside off but Tilak cannot get this away either. He looks for the sweep but ends up shanking it to deep mid wicket
full toss outside off but Tilak cannot cash in. He scuffs it to extra cover and sets off for the run, only to be sent back. Shreyas takes aim but misses. Tilak off the hook
dipping full toss near the thigh. Jacks drop-kicks it towards deep mid wicket and settles for a single
stop that, Will Jacks! This is outrageously good hitting. Length ball outside off. Jacks goes through the line and crrrrrrrunnnnchhhhessss it over extra cover!

thumped into the sightscreen, and Tilak has ripped Jansen to shreds! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off and Tilak knows this is coming too. He winds up and smokes it over the bowler's head!
safe! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Jacks throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to sweeper cover
Jacks joins in on the fun now! Jansen tests out the middle of the track again but this is again laced with width. Jacks frees his arms and slaps it over extra cover!
length ball on the stumps and this keeps a tad low. Tilak continues swinging and drags it towards deep mid wicket
this is an incredible shot! Jansen misses the middle-stump yorker on the shorter side now. Tilak gets under it and lifts it beautifully over mid off!
slower ball on leg, and deposited into the stands! Tilak reads it like the morning daily, bends his back knee and mooses it over deep square leg!
short and wide outside off. Tilak walks across, fetches it and swats it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on the pads. Jacks rolls his wrists and tucks it towards deep backward square leg
hard length, honing into middle and off. Jacks hops around his crease before prodding it back to the bowler

no need to review this, because Rutherford is outta here! Fullish outside off and Rutherford looks to go downtown. The bat face opens a little upon contact, though, and Rutherford arrows it straight down Bartlett's throat at long off. Massive wicket, with Rutherford threatening a heist, and PBKS just nudge ahead in this contest again!

banged into the track outside off. Rutherford has an agricultural mow across the line and misses. And as soon as he spins back into his original position, he signals for the review. Top of Rutherford's head is measured at 1.869m but the ball is passing through at 1.771m. No wide!
slower short ball wide outside off. Balloons past the batter and Rutherford is happy to let it go. Not called a wide
short and wide outside off. Rutherford reaches out for it and dabs it towards backward point
oh my goodness - Rutherford has hit this into next week! Dragged down a touch outside leg. Rutherford rocks back and smokes it an absolute mile over deep square leg. And it is still going!
fullish on the pads. Tilak skips down the track and works it towards deep mid wicket
four more, and Tilak is taking down Chahal! Googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Tilak brings out the reverse and helps it past short third!
shortish on the stumps. Tilak hops back and drags it behind square for a couple of runs
Tilak lays into Chahal first ball! Floaty full ball outside off. Tilak gets down on one knee, fetches it and clobbers it over long on. Onto the roof, and that six has been measured at 106m!
low full toss just outside off. Tilak nearly swings himself off his feet and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
slower short ball outside off. Tilak jumps up onto his toes and swings hard at it. Fails to make contact and the umpire calls it a wide again. No review this time
sizzling yorker, well inside the tramlines on the off side. Tilak is a touch late to pick up the line and swishes at thin air. Arshdeep outthought the batter there

banged in and following the batter outside leg. Tilak swipes at it and misses, and the umpire, rather belatedly, calls it a wide. And PBKS, after some deliberation, review. The line is fine. Height could also be fine. Seems touch-and-go this. Top of Tilak's head is measured at 1.855m but the ball is passing through at 1.831m. Decision overturned!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rutherford drives it down the ground to long off

shanked up in the air and put down! Short ball just outside off. Tilak shapes for the pull but the ball gets big on him. Miscues it and Jansen, running in from long on, dives to his right but cannot quite hold on with his outstretched right hand. Tough chance but another chance that has gone begging!
finds the gap to perfection! Shortish outside off. Tilak rises with the bounce and opens his bat face to knife it past backward point!
Poke and a miss. Rutherford looking to counter the lack of pace by walking down but this 123ks length ball gets extra bounce as he looks to defend to cover
Not too short but angling down, pulled to deep fine leg
Slow again. Fullish on leg, flicked to square leg
Leading edge rolls to cover, who's on the edge of the ring. Knuckle ball on a fullish length at leg stump, Tilak looked to flick it softly with a closed face
Slower back of length ball just outside off, guided to deep third. 114ks
Back of length on middle, looked to have seamed in. Turned actually, 112ks. Finishes over the stumps, flicked to deep fine leg
Looks to drag it across with a pull, misses. Rutherford twirled fully there. He wanted wide but that was just inside the tramline. Back of length, looked slow
Too wide, cut again. Touch back of length, seams in but rises evenly for Rutherford to cut hard behind point
Too wide, let go. Back of length, close to the return crease as it passes batter
Dances down to the shortish ball and slaps it to cover. Checked the shot there
Doesn't miss when the pacer errs. Half-volley on leg stump has been picked up behind square with ease
Length outside off, patted towards cover point
Slower inswinger beats the pull. Back of length just outside off, Tilak looked to pull it square and aerially
Similar ball, touch floatier. 88ks. Flicked to midwicket
Should've been swept, it hits pad instead. Was a full ball that landed just outside leg, Rutherford went hard for the sweep
Length on leg, 89ks, flicked through square leg
Not to short or wide, but it's cut through cover point. 92ks
Pitched up just outside off, punched to long-off
Fullish just outside off, pushed to cover's right for a quickie
Length on off, defended to the bowler's right
Shreyas half-stops it at mid-off but ball bursts through. Pitched up on off, Tilak muscled a drilled drive
Line too straight, helped fine with a leg glance. 132ks cross-seam length ball is on leg. Tilak stays in the crease to use the angle
Length on off, slides away as he drives to cover
Length just outside off, defended into the leg side of the pitch. Bat was going away from the body, Tilak checked his shot
Quick single to point's left. 130ks length ball on off, defended with an open-faced vertical bat
Flatter length ball on middle and off, punched to long-off. 92ks
Beaten again. Rutherford tentative again. Googly on a length lands on off and goes away with the angle. Bat's touching pad as the batter looks to defend straight
Looks to defend it straight. Was searching for it. Length ball on off goes to the off side

Stand and deliver - Rohit stands, Yuzi delivers. Yuzi jumps in delight as a smiling Shreyas approaches. 96ks legbreak lands on a length on middle and off and turns away. Rohit was stagnant as he tried to drive it through cover, lost his bottom hand while finishing. His struggle ends
Length on middle, flicked to midwicket off the back foot. 92ks

Direct hit from Omarzai at the non-striker's. Sent upstairs. Pop-up replay shows Rohit's slid the bat in. Length ball outside off bunted with the turn to backward point. Stump's broken, replacement being brought in
Turns away. Legbreak lands on a length but the starting line is wide and it's let go
Delicately guided through first slip. Good ball. On a length, just outside off. Tilak waited and criss-crossed the bat gently to get it fine

miscued pull, and Jansen breaks through! Sharp short ball on off and this gets big on Dhir. He looks to swipe it away but the bounce is tough to control. Skews it off the top edge and the ball spoons up to deep backward square leg, where Arshdeep does the rest. PBKS go back-to-back!
shortish on the stumps. Rohit gets inside the line and shovels it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
bumper on leg. Dhir rolls his wrists and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Rohit tucks it towards deep mid wicket and is content with a single
watch that ball fly! Dug in short on off. Rohit dances down the track, stands up tall and swats it over long on!
shortish on off and this keeps a touch low. Rohit looks to smash it into the mountains and drags it to deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Sticks a little in the surface and Rohit scuffs it to extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhir goes back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
slid through again, on a length on middle and off. Dhir advances before jabbing it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Rohit hangs back and knocks it to long on
slider on a length on middle and off. Rohit stabs it back to the bowler
class written all over that! In the slot outside off and this travels. Dhir establishes a solid base, shows the full face of the bat and crashes it over mid off!
back of a length on off, and this keeps a little low. Rohit hangs back and turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Dhir gets up on his toes and jabs it towards sweeper cover

Rickelton perishes for the cause, and Omarzai breaks this threatening stand! Fullish on middle and leg. Rickelton gets down on one knee, trying to help it over deep square leg. Does not get the elevation he wants, though, and he could not have picked out Arya better at deep backward square leg. Big, big moment in the game!
back of a length on middle and off. Rohit waits on it before tucking it behind square
slower ball on a length outside off. Rickelton gets on top of the bounce and drives it past extra cover
back of a length outside off, and this leaves the batter late. Rohit throws the lot at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
Rohit joins the party now! Marginally short outside off and that is all Rohit needs. He opens up his stance and wallops it over mid wicket!
full outside off. Rickelton presses forward and drives it to Shashank at extra cover, who misfields and ends up conceding a single
length ball outside off and this seems to come back in a touch. Rickelton wafts at it but for a change, is beaten on the inside. Might have been a change-up - was bowled at 115.4kph
another brilliant shot! On a length outside off. Rickelton gets onto the front foot, goes through the line and pumps it over mid on!
full and wide outside off. Rickelton throws his hands at it but plonks it off the bottom part of the bat towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off and this zips off the surface too. Rohit has a wild hack at it and misses
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton stays back and pats it into the point region
dispatched again! This is in the slot outside off. Rickelton, pressing forward, frees his arms and bangs it over mid off!
back of a length outside off. Rohit gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point
back of a length outside off and this skids off the surface. Rohit shapes for the cut but is beaten for pace
back of a length outside off. Rohit looks to go downtown but chalks it off the toe-end towards mid off
on a length outside off. Rickelton gets a half stride in before jabbing it towards cover
smashed down the ground! Over-pitched outside off. Rickelton transfers his weight forward and drills it back past the bowler!
pick the bones out of this one! Back of a length just outside off. Rickelton plants his front foot and whacks it a mile over mid wicket!
back of a length on leg and this skids through. Rickelton is late on the flick and he cops a blow on the inside of the knee for his troubles
back of a length on off. Rohit takes a step down the track before patting it into the cover region
back of a length outside off. Rickelton hangs back and dabs it towards deep backward point
back of a length on middle and leg. Keeps a little low and Rickelton tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
more runs, and this is not great bowling! Back of a length and sliding down leg again. Rickelton uses the pace and glances it past short fine leg!
flat as a tank! Full and sneaking into the pads. Rickelton plants his front foot and whips it flat over the long leg fence!
over the top again! Back of a length in the channel. Rickelton picks it up early and muscles it over mid wicket. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length outside off and this shapes away. Rickelton has a wild whoosh across the line and only connects with the thin mountain air
back of a length outside off. Rickelton tips it to the bowler's right and sets off. Rohit does not move a muscle at the other end. Damage averted as Jansen fails to gather
back of a length outside off. Rickelton waits on it before guiding it towards deep backward point
this is a Rickelton special! Shortish and sitting up on middle and leg. Rickelton uses the angle from around the wicket and dumps it over the long leg fence!
fullish just outside off. Seems like a knuckle ball. Rohit bunts it to mid wicket and calls for a single. A clean pick-up by Shashank, and Rohit might have been struggling
on a length outside off and this swings away too. Rohit presses forward before shouldering arms
just over! Back of a length outside off, shaping away. Rohit throws his hands at it and clinks it just beyond cover. Back for a brace
sharp work in the field. Full outside off. Rickelton gets forward and laces his off-drive. Shreyas lunges to his right and saves three
back of a length outside off, going on with the angle. Rohit hangs back and drops it into the off side with soft hands
back of a length just outside off and this shapes back in a shade. Rohit hops up onto his toes and pats it into the mid wicket region
back of a length outside off and this goes on with the angle too. Rohit has a dab at it and sees the ball whistle past his bat
pushed across on a length outside off. Rohit watches the ball go through to the keeper
back of a length on middle and off. Rickelton tips it to mid wicket and hurtles across to the other end. Risky run but he made it
back of a length outside off. Swings away a touch and Rohit, riding the bounce, runs it down to deep backward point
